speaker: Mr Mark Lee (Nominated Member)
text: I was wondering because if you read the newspaper article on TODAY, there are certain sectors that are saying that there is a large skills mismatch, especially for the tech sector.

speaker: Mr Mark Lee (Nominated Member)
text: Perhaps we can work more closely with the business community to ensure that there is more transparency and more signposts for individuals to understand what skills are required within certain specific industries.

speaker: Mr Mark Lee (Nominated Member)
text: The trade associations are wanting to work hand-in-hand with you.

speaker: Mr Mark Lee (Nominated Member)
text: And maybe there would be a requirement for higher subsidies for maybe the hottest skills that are needed and less for skills that are currently in less demand.
